description.zh: 资源归属账号的ID，资源归属账号是实际使用资源的账号。
description.en: The ID of the member. If you specify this parameter, the bills of the member are queried. If you do not specify this parameter, the bills of the current account are queried by default.
The billing cycle. Specify the parameter in the YYYY-MM format.

description.zh: 账单日期，仅当Granularity为DAILY时必填，格式为YYYY-MM-DD。
description.en: The billing date. This parameter is required only when the Granularity parameter is set to DAILY. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

description.zh:
查询账单的颗粒度。取值：
- MONTHLY：月。与用户中心-分账账单-账期账单一致。
- DAILY：日。与用户中心-分账账单-按天账单一致。

> 选择DAILY需指定BillingDate。
description.en:
The granularity at which bills are queried. Valid values:

*   MONTHLY: queries bills on a monthly basis. The data that you query is the same as the data that is queried by billing cycles in the Split Bill module of the User Center console.
*   DAILY: queries bills on a daily basis. The data that you query is the same as the data that is queried by days in the Split Bill module of the User Center console.

If you specify DAILY for this parameter, the BillingDate parameter is required.

description.zh:
根据原价（PretaxGrossAmount）和应付（PretaxAmount）是否都为0做过滤。取值：

- false。
- true。
description.en:
Specifies whether to filter bills if both the pretax gross amount and pretax amount are 0. Valid values:

*   false: does not filter bills.
*   true: filters bills.

description.zh: 本次读取的最大数据记录数量。默认值：20，最大值：300。
description.en: The maximum number of entries to query. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 300.

description.zh: 用来表示当前调用开始读取的位置，参数值必须为空或者使用返回结果中的NextToken设值，否则会报错。空代表从头开始读取。
description.en: The token that is used for the next query. The parameter must be left empty or set to the value of the NextToken parameter returned in the last call. Otherwise, an error is returned. If the parameter is left empty, the data is queried from the first entry.

description.zh: 产品Code，与费用中心账单产品Code一致。
description.en: The code of the service. The code is the same as that in Cost Center.
The ID of the split item.

description.zh:
订阅类型。取值：

- Subscription：预付费。
- PayAsYouGo：后付费。

> 必须和ProductCode参数一起使用。
description.en: The billing method. Valid values: Subscription: the subscription billing method. PayAsYouGo: the pay-as-you-go billing method. This parameter must be used with the ProductCode parameter.

description.zh: 标签过滤条件，支持多组标签查询条件TagValues。多组TagValues条件之间为或关系。
description.en: The tags that are used to filter split bills. You can specify multiple tag values. If you specify multiple tag values, split bills that match one of the tag values are queried.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun bssopenapi describe-split-item-bill --billing-cycle 2020-03 --product-code rds --product-type rds --subscription-type PayAsYouGo --next-token CAESEgoQCg4KCmd --max-results 20 --bill-owner-id 123 --instance-id i-kjhdskjgshfdlkjfdh --split-item-id i-kjhdskjgshfdlkjfdh --granularity Monthly --billing-date 2020-03-02 --tag-filter '[{"TagKey":"TestKey","TagValues":["TestValue"]}]' --is-hide-zero-charge false --pip-code rds --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun bssopenapi DescribeSplitItemBill --region cn-hangzhou --BillingCycle '2020-03' --NextToken CAESEgoQCg4KCmd --ProductCode rds --InstanceID 'i-kjhdskjgshfdlkjfdh' --IsHideZeroCharge false --MaxResults 20 --TagFilter.1.TagKey TestKey --ProductType rds --BillOwnerId 123 --BillingDate '2020-03-02' --Granularity Monthly --PipCode rds --SplitItemID 'i-kjhdskjgshfdlkjfdh' --SubscriptionType PayAsYouGo --TagFilter.1.TagValues.1 TestValue
